text:
Ana Patel: FYI I'm stuck at the airport, flight just delayed. Need to flip primary for tonight's shift 22:00-02:00. I can stay secondary if someone can take primary for the window. Sorry for late ask.
Mike Chen: I can cover primary from 22:00-02:00. Quick q: any active incidents or pages I should be aware of before handoff?
Ana Patel: Thanks Mike. There's no active Sev1 right now, but we had a transient latency uptick in us-west last hour. It recovered, but paging noise was seen for the embeddings cluster. Incident bot posted a notice: thread in #incidents.
incident-bot: Automated update: 1 open alert (embeds-latency-us-west), 3 recent pages in the last 60m. See /incidents/INC-2028 for details.
Sara Gomez: @Mike good to take it. We suppressed noisy alerts after tuning threshold at 18:40, but keep an eye on KV cache evictions (runbook note).
Mike Chen: Copy. Any runbook pointers for embeds-latency? Which playbook step is reliable?
Ana Patel: Use the embeds-latency runbook -> section "quick-patch" then "scale-burst". Key steps: check node mem pressure, rotate model variant to quantized3 if RTT spikes, and enable temporary extra pool if QPS > 1200/s.
Ana Patel: Short snippet I use to check mem:
```
# on runtime nodes
sudo /opt/redwood/bin/inspect --cluster embeds-us-west --metric mem.free
kubectl top pods -l app=embeds-us-west
```
If you need to rotate model: update routing policy in console: Routing -> us-west -> preferred: rdx-embed-q3 -> Save -> monitor.
Joel Rivera: Heads-up: if you rotate to quantized3, golden tests occasionally degrade token quality in edge cases; keep QA channel notified. Also, monitor the quality regression alert in Redwood Optimize.
Mike Chen: Got it. I'll take primary. Do you want me to do a quick handover checklist before 22:00?
Ana Patel: Yes please — quick checklist: 1) confirm no open Sev>1, 2) post handover note with primary/secondary and coverage hours, 3) confirm on-call shadow and escalation steps (PD escalation to oncall-lead at 15m), 4) copy runbook links.
Sara Gomez: I can be standby for the first 30 minutes after flip in case anything pops.
Mike Chen: Posting handover now: "Primary: Mike Chen (22:00-02:00), Secondary: Ana Patel, Standby: Sara Gomez (22:00-22:30). Monitoring: embeds-latency-us-west; runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeds-latency. PD escalation: oncall-lead after 15m." :thumbsup:
Ana Patel: :thumbsup: Thanks Mike. One more: if you see elevated error 504s on /v1/embed infer, try the KV cache flush step in runbook step 4, it usually stabilizes within a minute.
Mike Chen: Noted. I'll also patch the alert thresholds to avoid the flapping we saw. I'll leave a comment in the incident if I touch thresholds.
incident-bot: Note: schedule change detected — oncall primary updated: previous: Ana Patel, new: Mike Chen (22:00-02:00). Audit ID: audit-7753.
Joel Rivera: Thanks for covering. Mike — ping me in #eng-sre if you want me to shadow during any escalation.
Mike Chen: Thanks all. I'll take primary and will DM Ana a quick state dump at 21:50. Will post back here after the handoff.
Ana Patel: Appreciate it. Safe flight.
Mike Chen: 21:55 handover complete: DMed Ana the state dump and verified runbook links. Primary swap confirmed.
Ana Patel: Confirmed. Leaving secondary in place. Good luck, team.
